caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a simple wooden agricultural tool, possibly a primitive plow or digging implement. The tool consists of three main parts: a long, curved handle extending upward and to the left, a horizontal beam that forms the base, and a vertical peg situated near the center of the beam. The beam has a pointed end projecting to the right. The coloration is predominantly various shades of light and medium brown, accented with subtle wood grain textures to indicate the material is wood. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The drawing is signed "V. Van Voris" in small, neat text in the lower right corner.
title: Wooden Plow
